say:1:1022024001:1.text: Working on the ward with you again is almost like old times. If I'd known this moment was coming, our last farewell might not have felt so bittersweet.
say:1:1022024001:1.source_cn: 没想到还会有再次和你一道调整这个法阵的机会……早知道这...
say:1:1022024001:1.male: Working on the ward with you again is almost like old times. If I'd known this moment was coming, our last farewell might not have felt so bittersweet.
say:1:1022024001:1.female: Working on the ward with you again is almost like old times. If I'd known this moment was coming, our last farewell might not have felt so bittersweet.

say:2:1022024002:1.text: After you left, Cassadee would often stop by the study the ward. We had plenty of discussions about it.
say:2:1022024002:1.source_cn: 你离开之后，科丝蒂经常会过来研究你留下的术式，我们之间...
say:2:1022024002:1.male: After you left, Cassadee would often stop by the study the ward. We had plenty of discussions about it.
say:2:1022024002:1.female: After you left, Cassadee would often stop by the study the ward. We had plenty of discussions about it.

say:3:1022024003:1.text: She's got some fascinating ideas. Her understanding of you—or rather, the historical you—is surprisingly deep. It's intriguing, to say the least.
say:3:1022024003:1.source_cn: 她有不少奇思妙想，而且对你——我是说历史中的你——了解...
say:3:1022024003:1.male: She's got some fascinating ideas. Her understanding of you—or rather, the historical you—is surprisingly deep. It's intriguing, to say the least.
say:3:1022024003:1.female: She's got some fascinating ideas. Her understanding of you—or rather, the historical you—is surprisingly deep. It's intriguing, to say the least.

say:4:1022024004:1.text: But this ward isn't about history. It's about us—the memories we've etched into it together.
say:4:1022024004:1.source_cn: 不过，此刻面前的这个法阵，并不属于历史，而是属于我们的记忆。
say:4:1022024004:1.male: But this ward isn't about history. It's about us—the memories we've etched into it together.
say:4:1022024004:1.female: But this ward isn't about history. It's about us—the memories we've etched into it together.

say:5:1022024005:1.text: In your absence, I studied it relentlessly. I might even understand it better than you now.
say:5:1022024005:1.source_cn: 在你离开的这段时间，不断凝视着它的我，可能比起现在的你...
say:5:1022024005:1.male: In your absence, I studied it relentlessly. I might even understand it better than you now.

say:7:1022024006:1.text: It would be my honor. It's exactly what I've been wishing for, my dear Merlin.
say:7:1022024006:1.source_cn: 我很荣幸——不如说，这正是我所期望的。老师。
